Messages.Author: Dustin Cote
Messages.Body:
I know we're anxiously awaiting BloodLines in December, but I was
wondering if this was the last one, or if there was one more announced
after this that hasn't been named.

I'm refering to quotes made back when Sabbat War was selling out. It
did so well, WhiteWolf promised (3?) (2?) new sets? One of them was
Final Nights, and another was promised but unnamed. I just can't
remember if it was BloodLines, or if there was one after that, that
was going to be released.

Long stupid story short: Is there another release scheduled after
BloodLines? Or do we have to wait and see how sales go?
